# whisper-desk

> Offline voice dictation for Linux, WSL and macOS. A global shortcut opens an
> overlay, and text transcribed locally with faster-whisper is typed at the
> cursor, sentence after sentence. No data leaves the machine; transcription
> runs on an NVIDIA GPU when available, otherwise on the CPU.

- Source and issues: https://github.com/hermez-agency/whisper-desk
- Install script: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hermez-agency/whisper-desk/main/install.sh
- License: MIT
